items.Sentence: Primary treatment occurs in Pond 1, which is described in the treatment plant classification form as being 1,115,000 gallons, 12 feet deep, and is mixed and aerated.
Secondary treatment occurs in Pond 2, which is described in the treatment plant classification form as being 1,440,000 gallons, 17 feet deep, and is mixed and aerated.
Pond 3 provides some additional treatment in the form of polishing.
Effluent from Pond 3 is pumped via force main to an effluent storage pond (Sprayfield Pond) with an estimated capacity of 1,300,000 gallons five miles from the treatment facility.
Effluent disposal consists of two spray fields areas with a combined surface area of 11 acres.
As stated in the General Permit application, solids are stored within the ponds until removed by special pumping events.
